description: This file defines the LogFileReader class in the Aws\CloudTrail namespace. It provides functionality to retrieve, decompress, and parse AWS CloudTrail log files stored in Amazon S3, returning log records as an array.

classes.name: LogFileReader
classes.description: A class for reading and processing AWS CloudTrail log files stored in Amazon S3.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LogFileReader with an S3Client instance.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Downloads, decompresses, and parses a CloudTrail log file from Amazon S3, returning the log records as an array.
